contact_m.intro: Use this page to chat or exchange messages with %m%. KOBOOL urges both of you to involve your family in this process and to keep in mind that God is watching you. If you think that %m% is abusing you and is not serious about marriage, you can %h1%Decline%h0% from continuing this relationship.

notes.title: Notes
notes.note_1: To chat directly with %m%, both of you need to open this page at the same time. You can contact with %m% outside KOBOOL, but KOBOOL takes no responsibility if %m% abused your personal information (unfortunately this has become very common).
notes.note_2: Both of you can %h1%Add his picture%h0% and limit its' visibility to be for Only the member who I matched with, so that you can see each other in a private way.

decline.intro:
By submitting the following form, you declare that you withdraw form persuing a marriage relationship with %m%.
    As a result, KOBOOL will do the following:
  1. Send an email to let %m% know about your action.
  2. %m% will automatically be removed from your Acceptance List. however, you will not be automatically removed from %m%'s Acceptance List
  3. Both of you will again participate in the next Acceptance Matching operation and you might match with another members.
decline.note:
Important Note:
As soon as you submit the Decline form, both you and %m% will not be able to read the Messages that you exchanged before. If you already sent a recent message that %m% hasn't read yet, that message will never reach %m%. You can in this case write this message in the decline form's final message box, if you want to deliver it to %m%.
decline.warning:
Important Warning:
Some members misunderstand this step and think that the purpose of it is to withdraw from Kobool site after being matched to continue the communication with whom they matched with outside Kobool.
If you want to just withdraw from Kobool site don't use this form and use the Stop Membership form instead.
Because by declining via this form below you and %m% will participate in the next Acceptance Matching and both of you might match with other members from Kobool, and this is not recommended if you want to proceed with the marriage project with %m%.

Unfortunately, some members fully understand this step but they do it in order to be matched again with others so that they would be able to contact more than one candidate at the same time. That would mean that they are using Kobool service just for fun and that they are not serious.
We hope that this is not your in tension and that your Decline step is only because you don't accept %m% as a future spouse.
decline.message:
Final Message to '%m%'.

Please explain yours reasons for the decline in a nice way to avoid hurting '%m%''s feelings.

married.intro:
Submit the form below to declare that you and %m% had a successful marriage or engagement.
This will hide your profile from other KOBOOL members.

Upon submit this form, no one (except %m%) will be able to view your profile.

%m% has to submit the same form in order for KOBOOL to register you two as a successfully connected couple.
